overview: This enum selects the saved progress check that controls item unlocks, shop listings, and progress rewards.

None.simple: No unlock goal is set for this row.
None.technical: Both row constructors default UnlockConditionsType to EGameItemUnlockConditionsType::None. GameItem_GetUnlockProgress has no case for None and falls through to the never-passing (-1, 0) sentinel.

Default.simple: The item is available by default once its item set is unlocked.
Default.technical: GameItem_GetUnlockProgress adds FIntPoint(0, 0), which passes the progress check. GameShop_UnlockNewLineups still requires the item set to be unlocked and clears NewFlag.bNew for Default. The lineup and progress-reward text switches return GGameTextRequestNone.

StoryCharaRelateThreshold.simple: Raise the bond between two named characters.
StoryCharaRelateThreshold.technical: ValueStrs[0] and ValueStrs[1] name two characters. GetCharaRelateLevel must be at least ceil(Values[0]) in both directions. The unlock text uses those names and the integer-cast value in ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_0010.

StoryMissionClearRank.technical: ValueStrs[0] names a StoryDemo row. Story_IsDemoCleared_130F390 supplies the reached pair from the saved demo state. The lock uses (0, 1). The text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_0020 with the mission name and reads no numeric value.

StoryAllMissionClearRank.simple: Clear a free story mission with a high enough rank.
StoryAllMissionClearRank.technical: The branch scans free missions and their StudioMissionRecords_680 records. It passes when any record Rank is at least ceil(Values[0]). The text maps rank selector one to S and two to A, with values three and four mapped to B and C.

StoryChapterAllMissionClearRank.simple: Complete enough objectives in a named story chapter.
StoryChapterAllMissionClearRank.technical: ValueStrs[0] names a StoryChapter row. Story_GetChapterProgressPercent_1308AC0 supplies the current percentage against a required 100. The unlock text uses the chapter title in ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_0040.

StoryAllChapterClear.technical: Story_GetProgressFlagChapters_1302FC0 supplies the chapter list. Story_GetChapterProgressPercent_1308AC0 is tested for each chapter. The branch adds the reached pair when any chapter is below 100 percent and the locked pair when every chapter is at 100 percent.

StoryTotalClearMissionTask.simple: Clear a set number of objectives across progress-tracked story chapters.
StoryTotalClearMissionTask.technical: Story_GetChapterObjectiveCounts_1308D60 supplies cleared objective counts for progress-flag chapters. The current value is their sum capped at ceil(Values[0]) and the required value is ceil(Values[0]). Progress-reward text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_0060 with the integer-cast value.

StoryAllMissionTaskClear.simple: Clear all objectives across progress-tracked story chapters.
StoryAllMissionTaskClear.technical: Story_GetChapterObjectiveCounts_1308D60 supplies cleared and total objective counts for progress-flag chapters. The branch sums both and adds FIntPoint(Cleared, Total). Progress-reward text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_0070 with no numeric parameter.

StoryReleaseAllCorrelationDiagramCharact.simple: Release every character shown in the story character diagram.
StoryReleaseAllCorrelationDiagramCharact.technical: The branch gathers non-None Id_Character_Release entries from free demos. A character counts as released when its demo state in StudioMissionInts_6D0 is at least 2. It adds the number of unique released characters over the number of unique listed characters. Reward grants use GetType 6.

PvERiskValueThreshold.simple: Reach a target risk level in PvE.
PvERiskValueThreshold.technical: The current value is Header.StudioPvEMaxRiskValue_384 and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). Both unlock-text switches use ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_1010 with the integer-cast value. Reward grants use GetType 4.

PvEModePlayCount.simple: Play PvE a set number of times.
PvEModePlayCount.technical: The current value is the UserRecords record PvETotalCount and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). The lineup unlock text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_1020 with the integer-cast value.

PvEModeClearCount.simple: Clear PvE modes a set number of times.
PvEModeClearCount.technical: The current value adds the PvESurvivalModeClearCount and PvENormalModeClearCount records. The requirement is ceil(Values[0]). The lineup unlock text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_1030 with the integer-cast value.

PvEModeClearRankCount.simple: Clear PvE modes with a set number of high ranks.
PvEModeClearRankCount.technical: Values[0] selects the rank tier and Values[1] is the required count. Tier 1 counts PvEEvaluationSCount. Tier 2 counts PvEEvaluationSCount plus PvEEvaluationACount. Other tiers add the never-passing (-1, 0) sentinel.

PvENormalModeClearCount.simple: Clear normal PvE stages a set number of times.
PvENormalModeClearCount.technical: The current value is the PvENormalModeClearCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). Both unlock-text switches use ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_1040 with the integer-cast value.

PvESurvivalModeClearCount.simple: Clear survival PvE stages a set number of times.
PvESurvivalModeClearCount.technical: The current value is the PvESurvivalModeClearCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). Both unlock-text switches use ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_1050 with the integer-cast value.

PvETaskClearCount.simple: Clear PvE tasks a set number of times.
PvETaskClearCount.technical: The current value adds the PvETagTaskClearCount and PvESoloTaskClearCount records. The requirement is ceil(Values[0]). The lineup unlock text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_1060 with the integer-cast value.

PvEBindingVowsEquipmentCount.simple: Equip Binding Vows a set number of times.
PvEBindingVowsEquipmentCount.technical: The current value is the PvEBindingVowsEquipmentCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). The lineup unlock text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_1070 with the integer-cast value. Reward grants use GetType 4.

PvEGrowthCharaLevelThreshold.simple: Raise a named character to a target level.
PvEGrowthCharaLevelThreshold.technical: ValueStrs[0] names a character. Its PvECharacterExperiences value is converted with GamePvE_GetLevelFromExperience and compared with ceil(Values[0]). Unlock text uses the character name and the integer-cast level in ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_1090.

PvEGrowthAnyCharaLevelThreshold.simple: Raise any character to a target level.
PvEGrowthAnyCharaLevelThreshold.technical: The branch walks every PvECharacterExperiences entry. GamePvE_GetLevelFromExperience converts each experience value to a level and every qualifying character adds FIntPoint(0, 0). An empty result becomes the never-passing (-1, 0) sentinel.

PvETotalGrowthCharaLevelThreshold.simple: Reach a target combined level across characters.
PvETotalGrowthCharaLevelThreshold.technical: The current value is GamePvE_GetTotalLevel and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). The lineup unlock text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_1100 with the integer-cast value.

PvEHealPointUseCount.simple: Use healing points a set number of times.
PvEHealPointUseCount.technical: The current value is the PvEHealPointUseCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). Reward grants use GetType 4.

PvPBattleCount.simple: Fight PvP a set number of times.
PvPBattleCount.technical: The current value is the PvPBattleCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). Both unlock-text switches use ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_2010 with the integer-cast value.

PvPBattleWinCount.simple: Win PvP matches a set number of times.
PvPBattleWinCount.technical: The current value is the PvPTotalWinCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). The lineup unlock text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_2020 with the integer-cast value.

PvPBattleWinResultRankThreshold.simple: Win PvP matches with a set number of high ranks.
PvPBattleWinResultRankThreshold.technical: Values[0] selects the rank tier and Values[1] is the required count. Tier 1 counts PvPEvaluationSCount. Tier 2 counts PvPEvaluationSCount plus PvPEvaluationACount. Other tiers add the never-passing (-1, 0) sentinel.

PvPRankMatchWinCount.simple: Win ranked PvP matches a set number of times.
PvPRankMatchWinCount.technical: The current value is the PvPRankMatchWinCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). Progress-reward text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_2050 when that ceiling is one and ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_2070 otherwise.

PvPRankMatchWinningStreakCount.simple: Win ranked PvP matches in a row.
PvPRankMatchWinningStreakCount.technical: The current value is PvP.RankMatchWinningStreakCount and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). OpenPvPResult gathers every ProgressReward row with this condition and grants their item sets after the PvP result.

PvPRankPointMax.technical: ValueStrs[0] names a RankPoint row. Its Id_GlobalThreshold field selects a GlobalThreshold row. The condition passes when the PvPRankPointMax record is at least ceil(Threshold.Min). The text looks up the rank label through GSysRankingLabelMap using RankPointClass.

UseCharacterCount.simple: Use a named character in battles a set number of times.
UseCharacterCount.technical: ValueStrs[0] names a character. The current value adds PvPBattleCount, PvEBattleCount, and StudioBattleCount_0C from its CharacterRecords entry. A missing record contributes zero. The requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

StageSelectCount.simple: Select a named stage in battles a set number of times.
StageSelectCount.technical: ValueStrs[0] names a map. The current value is MapRecords.BattleCount for that map and a missing record contributes zero. The requirement is ceil(Values[0]). Unlock text uses the map name in ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_3020.

DashCount.simple: Dash a set number of times.
DashCount.technical: The current value is the DashCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

JustGuardCount.simple: Just-guard a set number of times.
JustGuardCount.technical: The current value is the JustGuardCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

GuardBreakCount.simple: Break an opponent guard a set number of times.
GuardBreakCount.technical: The current value is the GuardBreakCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

CursedEnergyLevelupCount.simple: Level up cursed energy a set number of times.
CursedEnergyLevelupCount.technical: The current value is the CursedEnergyLevelupCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

CursedEnergyAttackLevelMaxCount.simple: Max out cursed energy attacks a set number of times.
CursedEnergyAttackLevelMaxCount.technical: The current value is the CursedEnergyAttackLevelMaxCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

ShortRangeAttackCount.simple: Land short-range attacks a set number of times.
ShortRangeAttackCount.technical: The current value is the ShortRangeAttackCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

LongRangeAttackCount.simple: Land long-range attacks a set number of times.
LongRangeAttackCount.technical: The current value is the LongRangeAttackCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

DebuffCount.simple: Apply debuffs a set number of times.
DebuffCount.technical: The current value is the DebuffCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

SuperCursedEnergyAttackCount.simple: Use super cursed energy attacks a set number of times.
SuperCursedEnergyAttackCount.technical: The current value is the SuperCursedEnergyAttackCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

DomainExpansionCount.simple: Use domain expansions a set number of times.
DomainExpansionCount.technical: The current value is the DomainExpansionCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

SpecialTagComboCount.simple: Use special tag combos a set number of times.
SpecialTagComboCount.technical: The current value is the SpecialTagComboCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

FriendBattleCount.simple: Fight friends a set number of times.
FriendBattleCount.technical: The current value is the FriendBattleCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

TotalMoney.simple: Earn a set amount of money.
TotalMoney.technical: The current value is the TotalMoney record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]).

TotalCostume.simple: Own a set number of costumes.
TotalCostume.technical: GameItem_GetOwnedItems collects Costume rows without hidden entries. Rows with UserProgressFlag below zero and InitialPossession at or below zero are removed. The remaining count is compared with ceil(Values[0]).

TotalTitle.simple: Own a set number of titles.
TotalTitle.technical: GameItem_GetOwnedItems collects Title rows without hidden entries. Rows with UserProgressFlag below zero and InitialPossession at or below zero are removed. The remaining count is compared with ceil(Values[0]).

TotalCursedTools.simple: Own a set number of cursed tools.
TotalCursedTools.technical: GameItem_GetOwnedItems collects CursedTools rows without hidden entries. Rows with UserProgressFlag below zero and InitialPossession at or below zero are removed. The remaining count is compared with ceil(Values[0]).

UseMultiCharacterCount.simple: Use each listed character in battles a set number of times.
UseMultiCharacterCount.technical: Every non-None ValueStrs entry produces its own pair. Each pair adds that character PvPBattleCount, PvEBattleCount, and StudioBattleCount_0C against ceil(Values[0]). A missing record contributes zero and every pair must pass.

UseCharacterGroupCount.simple: Use a group of characters in battles a set number of times in total.
UseCharacterGroupCount.technical: The branch loops every ValueStrs entry, so None entries contribute zero. It sums PvPBattleCount, PvEBattleCount, and StudioBattleCount_0C for found records. The sum is compared once with ceil(Values[0]).

UsePvPCharacterGroupCount.simple: Use a group of characters in PvP a set number of times in total.
UsePvPCharacterGroupCount.technical: The branch skips None entries and sums PvPBattleCount for each remaining ValueStrs name that has a character record. The sum is compared once with ceil(Values[0]).

PvEModeClearRiskValue.simple: This unlock goal is reserved and never succeeds.
PvEModeClearRiskValue.technical: The GameItem_GetUnlockProgress case adds no progress pair. The shared fallthrough then adds the never-passing (-1, 0) sentinel. Reward and lineup checks read that sentinel when this type is used.

ArcadeModeClear.simple: Clear arcade mode at least once.
ArcadeModeClear.technical: The current value is min(ArcadeClearCount, 1) and the requirement is 1. The lineup unlock text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_6010.

ArcadeModeClearCount.simple: Clear arcade mode a set number of times.
ArcadeModeClearCount.technical: The current value is the ArcadeClearCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). The lineup unlock text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_6020.

ArcadeModeCharacterClear.simple: Clear arcade mode with each listed character.
ArcadeModeCharacterClear.technical: AddArcadeFlags reads FStudioArcadeClearFlags for each non-None ValueStrs name and checks Flags.Clear. Each character adds one pair with current flag 0 or 1 and required 1. The arcade plate widget filters rows by ValueStrs[0] and Plate item type.

ArcadeModeCharacterNoContinueClear.simple: Clear arcade mode without continuing with each listed character.
ArcadeModeCharacterNoContinueClear.technical: AddArcadeFlags reads FStudioArcadeClearFlags for each non-None ValueStrs name and checks Flags.NoContinueClear. Each character adds one pair with current flag 0 or 1 and required 1. The lineup unlock text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_6040.

ArcadeModeCharacterNoContinueClearHard.simple: Clear hard arcade mode without continuing with each listed character.
ArcadeModeCharacterNoContinueClearHard.technical: AddArcadeFlags reads FStudioArcadeClearFlags for each non-None ValueStrs name and checks Flags.HardClear. Each character adds one pair with current flag 0 or 1 and required 1. The lineup unlock text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_6050.

PvEExtraMissionCount.simple: Play PvE extra missions a set number of times.
PvEExtraMissionCount.technical: The current value is the PvEExtraMissionCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). Progress-reward text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_1140 and reward grants use GetType 4.

PvEExtraMissionClearCount.simple: Clear PvE extra missions a set number of times.
PvEExtraMissionClearCount.technical: The current value is the PvEExtraMissionClearCount record and the requirement is ceil(Values[0]). Progress-reward text uses ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_1150 and reward grants use GetType 4.

StoryMissionTaskClear.simple: Clear a specific objective in a named story mission.
StoryMissionTaskClear.technical: ValueStrs[0] names a StoryDemo row. static_cast<int32>(Values[0]) is the objective index passed to Story_IsDemoObjectiveCleared_130F3D0. Success adds FIntPoint(0, 0) and failure adds (0, 1). Reward grants use GetType 2.

TotalEquipment.simple: Own a set number of cursed tools and equipment pieces.
TotalEquipment.technical: GameItem_GetOwnedItems collects CursedTools, CursedObjects, and Extras rows. Tools are counted once per first 21 characters of Id.ToString and objects once per first 23 characters. Extras use the full Id. Hidden rows with UserProgressFlag below zero and InitialPossession at or below zero are removed.

UseKyotoStudentsCount.simple: Bring a set number of Kyoto students past a battle threshold.
UseKyotoStudentsCount.technical: Each non-None ValueStrs character adds one success when PvPBattleCount, PvEBattleCount, and StudioBattleCount_0C total at least ceil(Values[0]). The branch adds FIntPoint(Count, ValueStrs.Num()), so None slots remain in the required total.

Invalid.simple: This value is a reserved invalid marker.
Invalid.technical: Declared as the uint8 slot 255 in the enum header. No source consumer compares UnlockConditionsType with Invalid and no supplied export row uses it, so its intended gameplay meaning is unresolved.

notes: The header declares no aliases. Members from None through UseKyotoStudentsCount are sequential and Invalid is the reserved uint8 slot 255.

GameItem_GetUnlockProgress returns one or more FIntPoint(current, required) pairs. GameItem_IsProgressRewardReached and the shop unlock loop require current at least required for every pair. An empty result becomes the never-passing (-1, 0) sentinel.

Need(index) is FMath::CeilToInt(Values[index]). Most count conditions use Values[0] as a goal. PvEModeClearRankCount and PvPBattleWinResultRankThreshold use Values[0] as a rank selector and Values[1] as a count. StoryMissionTaskClear casts Values[0] to int32 as an objective index.
The unlock-text switches use static_cast<int32> for most displayed values. They are not exhaustive and can return no text request even when GameItem_GetUnlockProgress has a branch for the type.

Reward grants use GetType 2 for story conditions from StoryCharaRelateThreshold through StoryMissionTaskClear, GetType 6 for StoryReleaseAllCorrelationDiagramCharacter, GetType 4 for the listed PvE conditions and extra missions, and GetType 7 for other types.
Arcade character conditions use ValueStrs entries as FName keys into StudioArcadeClearFlags_C48 and check three separate flags.
The StoryAllChapterClear branch adds the reached pair while any progress-flag chapter is below 100 percent. This exact branch order is preserved in the reconstruction.

The supplied exports contain 40 distinct types across 493 ProgressRewardDataTable rows and 13 distinct types across 1009 ShopLineupDataTable rows. Several declared types have no row in either export but still have a traced runtime branch.
None reaches the shared default branch of GameItem_GetUnlockProgress. Invalid has no dedicated consumer in this checkout.
